sentences.en: The agreement was subsequently renegotiated, but details were not disclosed.
sentences.zh: 该协议随后重新谈判了，但细节并未披露。

sentences.en: Several witnesses subsequently recanted their statements claiming coercion.
sentences.zh: 几名证人后来撤回了他们声称受到胁迫的陈述。

sentences.en: The countries agreed to a disarmament treaty and subsequently withdrew their troops.
sentences.zh: 这些国家同意了一项裁军条约，并随后撤走了他们的军队。

senses.zh: 其后，随后，接着,“subsequent”的派生,嗣后,尔后
